{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Olendahu''''' was a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] that was used by the [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]-based company [[Renna's Transport Service]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

{{RPG}}
In c. [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], [[Renna (Rodian)|Renna]], the owner of Renna's Transport Service, loaned the ''Olendahu'' to the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance [[Agent/Legends|agents]] who were on a delivery mission for her. However, while the agents were returning from the assignment, the ship became caught in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]] due to the actions of a [[shadow creature]], which was draining passing [[Starship/Legends|starships]] of power.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Olendahu'' appears in the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philosophy|Philosophy]]'', and is loaned to the players&mdash;who role-play as the Heroes of Cularin&mdash;if the player characters do not own a starship of their own, but have the skills to use one.
